title: ClientSessionRevokedPayload

clientSessionId.description: A client session's id, as hello names it and the access methods list and revoke it.

reason.description: Why a client session was revoked: requested (access.sessions.revoke), replaced (a newer desktop bootstrap), or idle (a tui local client session whose last socket closed an hour before).

description: client-session.revoked: a client session was revoked; its sockets were closed and its token is refused.
